Title: Public Preview: Support 5x churn in Azure Site Recovery

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now supports up to 5x churn (500 MB/s per VM). This major enhancement empowers customers to confidently run high IOPS workloads with Azure Site Recovery, ensuring robust disaster recovery for even the most demanding applications like databases, big data and analytics systems, etc. 

Learn more.
